scope: Non-Claude pilot of the paired deterministic browser-tool matrix proposed in LockInTime/headless#161

methodology.aggregation: median of all three trials, including timeouts at observed wall time
methodology.validation: five backend-state checks plus runner exit and prohibited-tool-call checks
methodology.viewport: 1280x720 requested for Playwright MCP; Headless reported 1160x673 content viewport
methodology.cleanState: unique fixture run ID and browser session for every trial
methodology.startup: Headless host prestarted and reused; Playwright MCP used an isolated browser per trial
methodology.approvals: Codex --approve-for-me enabled because browser mutations carry approval-required annotations

unavailableMetrics: provider price snapshot and comparable dollar cost
separate agent, tool, and startup latency
